chain_waist.answer: McMaster's #35 chain CAD has waisted (figure-eight) plates, and its inner and outer plates differ. Inner (roller-link) plates: 8.81 mm high at the ends, waist 7.49 mm at mid-pitch (0.85 x height). Outer (pin-link) plates: 7.76 mm high, waist 6.39 mm (0.82 x their height; 0.73 x 8.79). Both waists are one concave arc of R 13.08 mm (dia. 26.16) per edge. v11 draws every plate 8.79 high with a 6.59 waist (0.75 x 8.79): McMaster's inner plates have 0.9 mm more waist than that, its outer plates 0.2 mm less and are 1.0 mm lower overall
chain_waist.source: McMaster-Carr 6261K172 (Roller Chain, Single Strand, ANSI Number 35, 3/8 in Pitch, steel, $5.07 per ft), 3-D STEP for a 1 ft length (McMaster drawing number 6261K291, 32 pitches), and 6261K191 (connecting link) 3-D STEP; the 2-D PDFs dimension only pitch 0.375, roller (bushing) 0.200, pin 0.141, roller width 0.188, plate thickness 0.050 and the connecting link's width 0.500 in, not the plate height or waist
chain_waist.method: STEP loaded with cadquery; each plate solid sliced across its length every 1/24 of it (0.002 mm slabs), the section's extent across the plate's height read at each station; hole and arc diameters from the cylindrical faces. The 1 ft STEP has 145 solids: 32 outer plates, 32 inner plates, 32 pins, 32 rollers, 17 bushings (as McMaster modelled them)
chain_waist.comparison: Pitch, pin dia. (3.58), bushing (5.08), plate thickness (1.27) and the inner plate's height (8.81 vs 8.79) agree with v11. McMaster's model differs on the outer plates (7.76 high, not 8.79), the waists (7.49 inner, 6.39 outer, not 6.59 for both) and the pin lengths (11.84, and 12.70 over a connecting link, against Nitro's 12.40 and 13.16). McMaster's CAD is McMaster's own model of its chain, not Nitro's; Nitro publishes no waist
chain_waist.how_read: headed Chromium through the doser Pi, logged out: the family table page, the part number clicked in the table, a 1 ft length picked in its panel, then the panel's CAD menu (3-D STEP, 2-D PDF). McMaster's product-detail pages (https://www.mcmaster.com/6261K172/) now answer 'Log in to view Product Detail' to a logged-out browser; the table and its panels do not
